answer: Pay honest agents to hunt fakes: each newcomer posts a bond and faces a randomly drawn vetting panel whose members stake their own standing on the verdict. Approve a fraud and the vetters lose stake; expose one and they split its bond. A sybil operator finances his own enemies — every clone becomes a beacon advertising a bounty, and the summit of his farm stands exposed. Honest newcomers pass once and keep their bond, while an onyx market in fake approvals collapses, since approving fakes costs more than the operator pays. Limit: panels must rotate anonymously, or bribery rots the hunt.
